name: test-reliability
title: Test reliability
summary: Rules we learned fixing flaky tests on our own board, ready for yours.

rules.text: No test waits on the wall clock or a fixed sleep.
rules.why: a test that sleeps is slow on an idle machine and flaky on a busy one.

rules.text: A flake is pinned on a change only after a run without it.
rules.why: a test that fails under load looks like a broken change until it fails without that change too.
